impacts.statement: Major flooding of lowlands, with some flooding of roads and structures along Trout Creek from Pioneer Trail to South Lake Tahoe.  About 750 cfs.

Flood Stage...with very minor lowland flooding along Trout Creek from Pioneer Trail to near Martin Avenue in South Lake Tahoe.  About 386 cfs.
Bankfull...but no flooding in reach.  About 275 cfs.
